title: beta-customer-onboarding-readiness-and-feedback-pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
body:
Summary:
This ticket coordinates pre-launch readiness for a closed beta cohort of lighthouse customers for the upcoming private and dedicated deployment features (VPC onboarding, RBAC, and audit logs). The goal is to define criteria for customer participation, align cross-functional responsibilities, finalize release notes and technical onboarding artifacts, and set up a tight feedback loop to iterate during the beta window.

Objectives:
- Recruit 5–8 lighthouse accounts with representative workloads (SaaS PLG, regulated enterprise, platform team).
- Complete a runbook for onboarding that reduces time-to-first-query to <72 hours for dedicated/private deployments.
- Publish release notes and a consolidated technical FAQ 48 hours before customer kickoff.
- Collect structured feedback from each account weekly and map to actionable backlog items with priorities and owners.
- Define success criteria for graduating from beta to GA.

Success criteria (must-have to consider beta successful):
- 80% of lighthouse customers complete onboarding and run a baseline test suite within two weeks.
- Average 95th-percentile API latency stays within SLA targets for dedicated pools during monitored windows.
- Zero critical data security issues; any P1/P0 must be resolved or have an agreed mitigation.
- At least three product/UX improvements created from direct customer feedback with accepted follow-up plans.

Launch artifacts to finalize (owners in parens):
- Beta onboarding runbook (PM: Aisha) – step-by-step ops checklist, sample IAM/KMS snippets, templates for customer network setup.
- Release notes (PM: Marco) – public-facing summary + technical appendix with API changes and migration notes.
- Customer-facing FAQ (Support: Lina) – triage guide and escalation matrix.
- Playbook for post-onboarding health checks (SRE: Priya) – dashboards and alert thresholds.
- Feedback intake form + schema (Data: Omar) – to standardize issue categorization and sentiment scoring.

Release notes coordination plan:
1) Draft technical appendix with engineering (ENG-2147) by 2025-02-18.
2) Design review for release notes visual and markdown templates (DES-412) by 2025-02-19.
3) Legal/security sign-off on copy and any customer-facing requirements by 2025-02-21.
4) Final publish to Docs + pinned Console banner 48 hours before kickoff (target publish: 2025-03-01).

Go-to-market and outreach tasks:
- Identify lighthouse candidates and confirm participation (PM outreach: Aisha + Sales SE: Jonah). Contact script in /drive/launch/lighthouse-outreach (placeholder link).
- Assign a dedicated SE/AE for each customer and schedule an initial scoping call within 3 business days of acceptance.
- Coordinate marketing teaser email and in-product messaging post-beta (Growth: Sima).
- Create a customer advisory sync cadence: weekly technical touchpoint + biweekly business review.

Feedback loop and evaluation process:
- Weekly standardized feedback submission using the Data feedback intake form. Fields: category, severity, reproducible_steps, sample_request_id, impact_estimate.
- Triage meeting every Tuesday 09:00 PT with PM, Eng lead, SRE, Design, and Support. Items triaged into: quick-fix (<3 days), backlog candidate (sprint-plannable), or blocker (immediate).
- Monthly retrospective with customers at the end of beta month 1 to validate product direction and collect qualitative quotes.

Metrics and dashboards to monitor:
- Onboarding velocity: days from invite to workload run.
- Operational SLOs: 99th and 95th latency, error rates by model/route.
- Cost deltas: per-request unit economics for beta vs. baseline.
- Feedback health: number of issues, severity distribution, time-to-triage.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Network/VPC setup complexity delays onboarding. Mitigation: provide pre-configured terraform templates and dedicated SE runbook; offer one dedicated engineering office hour per customer in week 1.
- Risk: Performance regressions under customer load. Mitigation: run synthetic load tests with representative sequences before customer data onboarded; enable automatic fallback to compatible model variant.
- Risk: Incomplete release notes cause customer confusion. Mitigation: lock technical appendix early and route to Legal & Security for sign-off, publish separate FAQ for migration gotchas.

Acceptance criteria for closing this ticket:
- All artifacts in 'Launch artifacts to finalize' are published and linked.
- First 3 lighthouse customers accept invites and schedule kickoff calls.
- Monitoring dashboards for SLOs and onboarding velocity live in Console and accessible to stakeholders.
- Feedback intake pipeline is validated with at least one real feedback item and triaged.

Communication templates (examples placed in Drive):
- Invite email subject: "Redwood Private Beta: Next steps and kickoff"
- Kickoff agenda: intro, scope, network checklist, test plan, support model, Q&A, next steps.
- Weekly sync agenda: open issues, recent incidents, performance snapshot, action items.

Recent updates and notes:
- 2025-02-11 — Aisha: Reached out to three potential lighthouse accounts (FintechCo, EduPlatform, RetailAI). FintechCo expressed particular interest but flagged KMS integration timeline.
- 2025-02-12 — Marco: Drafted initial release notes appendix; waiting on ENG-2147 to confirm API schema changes.
- 2025-02-14 — Priya: Created initial health-check dashboard template and shared with the team (link in Drive). Alert thresholds provisional.
- 2025-02-17 — Jonah: Sales confirmed two enterprise customers willing to be lighthouse accounts if a two-week SLA pilot is included. Need legal approval for SLA pilot language.
- 2025-02-18 — Engineering (ENG-2147): Completed compatibility matrix for model variants and fallback behavior. Added notes on expected latency profile per pool size.
- 2025-02-20 — Lina (Support): Compiled top 10 anticipated support questions; recommend adding dedicated KB article for network troubleshooting.

Open action items:
- Marco: finalize and circulate release notes draft for Legal review by 2025-02-21.
- Aisha/SEs: confirm lighthouse participation and map owners by 2025-02-24.
- Eng: run synthetic load for FintechCo profile and report latency curves by 2025-02-25.
- Design: review customer-facing FAQ layout and approve by 2025-02-22.

Files/links to add to the ticket (placeholders to be replaced with real links):
- /drive/launch/beta-onboarding-runbook-v1.docx
- /drive/launch/release-notes-appendix.md
- /drive/launch/lighthouse-outreach-template.docx
- github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/842 (pre-configured terraform templates)
- grafana.redwood/internal/dashboards/onboarding-beta

Notes for PMs taking over this ticket later:
- Maintain weekly triage rhythm; keep feedback schema consistent to enable rapid analysis.
- Avoid scope creep: focus the beta on validating onboarding friction and core operational SLOs rather than surface new feature requests.
- Keep the communications cadence conservative—customers should feel supported but not overwhelmed.
